## Purpose

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest complete change made.

## Verification

- [ ] Python lint and compile pass.
- [ ] Automated tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend lint and production build pass.
- [ ] Dependency and repository hygiene checks pass.
- [ ] User-visible behavior was checked through the relevant real workflow.

## Safety

- [ ] No API keys, private scripts, user projects, generated images, or logs are included.
- [ ] Project format changes include backward-compatible defaults or migration.
- [ ] The change does not claim packaged-app verification unless that exact artifact was run.
